entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If the map's right, we still got a long[n]way to go...
entries.uk: Якщо мапа не бреше,[n]нам іще йти та йти...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's not all—there are an awful lot of[n]patrolling Shadows, too.
entries.uk: Це ще не все — тут страшенно[n]багато патрульних Тіней.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now, you can't just blindly rush into[n]a fight. First you need to ascertain[n]how strong they are.
entries.uk: Не можна сліпо кидатися в бій.[n]Спершу треба з'ясувати,[n]наскільки вони сильні.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How're we supposed to do that?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, we'll need to observe the enemy's[n]actions and get some insight into their[n]skills.
entries.uk: Ну, треба стежити за діями ворога[n]й так дізнаватися про його[n]здібності.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You should be capable of that, Joker.
entries.uk: Тобі це має бути до снаги, Джокере.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like we're in for some tough work...
entries.uk: Схоже, на нас чекає важка робота...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, but at least we have an idea on[n]how to do it! We'll be outta here in[n]no time.
entries.uk: Та ну, зате ми хоч знаємо, як це[n]робити! Оком не змигнемо,[n]як виберемося звідси.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Skull knows the score.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's take a look around. We'll be[n]relying on your keen eye.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh! Now there's something[n]we recognize...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yep, that was it! Let's go!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait! Hold on, Joker!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we go any further, we'll be stepping[n]right into a battle. What's your call,[n]Joker?
entries.uk: Якщо підемо далі, одразу втрапимо[n]в бій. Що вирішиш,[n]Джокере?

entries.en: Let's go right through them.
Let's look around a bit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah! Let's DO this!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, let's try using our wits.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You kind of just do what you feel like,[n]don't you...?
entries.uk: Ти просто робиш, що заманеться,[n]еге ж...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, Joker! I think that might be[n]our ticket past here!
entries.uk: Агов, Джокере! Здається, ось[n]наша перепустка далі!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Take a look, guys.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh... What IS that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dunno... Let's go find out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's, uh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously... More bars?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But there's a way to open it, right?[n]Let's start looking, Joker.
entries.uk: Але ж їх можна якось відчинити, так?[n]Починаймо шукати, Джокере.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Boy, there are an awful lot of bars[n]in here for being... what looks like[n]a dining room?
entries.uk: Ого, щось забагато тут ґрат як на...[n]їдальню, чи що це?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yep, sure looks like it to me. Now,[n]according to the map...
entries.uk: Так, як на мене, дуже схоже. Отже,[n]якщо вірити мапі...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's a path beyond those bars there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like they're making things[n]tougher for us yet again...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, it shouldn't be too bad. Let's just[n]get it done.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And that's that! Time to move!
